test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 7.**
solution:
The correct answer is: had become

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• “**had become**” is written in the past perfect.
 
• It describes the situation immediately before a point in the past, before going on to describe a situation at that point in the past.

 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: "**The HKV experience has developed into a bustling combination of cafés, art galleries, curio stores, gyms, and, of course, fashion retailers.**"
 
• "**had become**" is correct because the narrator is talking about his experience that happened before a specific point in the past.

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

Complete passage: *On Hauz Khas Road, at the entrance to the pedestrianised Hauz Khas Village, the guard (1) at __the barrier asks you to halt and directs __(2) you__ to the parking lot. It's 5 p.m. and the parking lot is nearly empty as shops are closed and there are __(3) hardly__ any shoppers. There aren't many people on the lane leading to the __(4) residential__ area either. This is unusual for HKV (as it is popularly known) __(5) because __it is one of Delhi's popular shopping areas. Initially a hub for designer __(6) clothes__, the HKV experience **__(7) had become__** a throbbing mix of cafes, art galleries, curio shops, gyms and, of course, fashion boutiques. The quirky neighbourhood was a hit (8)________ with youngsters and tourists for its happening nightlife. These days however, night comes hours (9)_______ dusk at HKV as you can only see street dogs, security guards, a few takeaway joint managers and bored attendants (10)________ to reach home early.*
